title: AgentFeedback integrations list
description: integrations.json at the repository root: one entry per harness adapter, agent platform and hub through which AgentFeedback is installed, with how far each was checked. It describes repository data, not the HTTP API.

id.description: Stable identifier; for an adapter, the harness name install takes.

kind.description: adapter: a harness install wires; platform: an agent platform with its own catalog; hub: a catalog or marketplace serving several harnesses; sink: a destination reports are forwarded to.

install.description: How a user installs through this integration, as Markdown.

status.description: How far the integration was checked or how far its submission went.

docs.description: Repository-relative path of the document covering this integration.
